| In the darkest of shadows, all is made clear. Pharloom draws its final breath, and we few remaining must bear its dying pain. Come to the Citadel's Stage and let us suffer together.

| Hr = SS

<b>Pain, Anguish and Misery</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It can be acquired from [[Songclave]]'s wishwall after obtaining the [[Claw Mirror]] from [[Trobbio]] and the [[Silk Soar]].

== Wish ==
To complete the wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must return to [[the Stage]] within the [[Whispering Vaults]] and find [[the Tormented One]].

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Trobbio 01.png!Tormented Trobbio's location in the Whispering Vaults
}}

There, she finds [[Tormented Trobbio]], who, tormented by the coming of [[Pharloom]]'s end, is ready to submit to the pain. Defeating him completes the wish.

== Reward ==
[[File:Dark Mirror.png|link=Dark Mirror|left|thumb|100x100px]]
[[File:Claw Mirrors.png|link=Claw Mirrors|right|thumb|100x100px]]

After Hornet defeats Tormented Trobbio, the [[Dark Mirror]] is flung out of a trapdoor. When picked up, it automatically combines with the Claw Mirror to become the [[Claw Mirrors]].

{{Clear}}
